Market today: The mood is cautious, especially for earlier market winners like tech/chip. Rising yields are the real driver, quietly putting pressure on these growth names, which directly impacts your concentrated portfolio.

Your holdings: SOXL (-29.29%) and SPAL (-17.02%) are in dire straits. Both are leveraged ETFs, marked "SELL," and have already fallen below their default stops, amplifying losses on margin.

Watch: Keep a close eye on interest rate movements and their continued impact on tech valuations. Also, monitor any further signs of rotation out of the AI/tech trade.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your leveraged losers to protect your capital in a challenging tech environment.
plays: SOXL: Your -29.29% loss on this leveraged ETF is significant. Given its "SELL" status and the fact it's blown past its default stop, seriously consider cutting losses to protect capital.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, this leveraged ETF is down -17.02% and has also breached its default stop. Review your risk tolerance and consider exiting to prevent further decay.
No new buys today - hold and watch. The market mood for tech/chip is cautious, and scanner setups are either "chasing" or lower conviction.
